name: Portal UI — connection creation
summary: Foundry portal supports creating BYOM connections, but only for v2 APIM resources fronting OpenAI-compatible chat completions APIs.
description: The Foundry portal's Operate → Admin console → Admin-connected models → Add wizard creates some connected-model providers, including `Azure API Management`. The user problem is whether the UI can create every BYOM connection category and upstream provider that the code/Bicep path supports.
notes:
Partially supported in the portal: the wizard creates Azure API Management and generic OpenAI-compatible sources, but ModelGateway and non-OpenAI provider configurations still require code or Bicep. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway?tabs=api-management&pivots=foundry-portal.

Technical facts preserved: `Azure API Management` requires a v2 APIM resource and an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API; the `Other source` option covers self-hosted or non-Azure OpenAI-compatible gateways, but still requires an OpenAI-compatible chat completions surface. Use the Bicep templates in `microsoft-foundry/foundry-samples` for ModelGateway and non-OpenAI providers such as Anthropic, OpenRouter, LiteLLM, and DeepSeek.
